serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Welcome my dear Anon! I heard that you wanted to give me double the money this week~
You: From who? I never said anything like that.
Landlord: I wouldn’t mind it.
You: Not a chance! Why would I pay you extra?
Landlord: Tsk. Fine.
You: …
Landlord: Oops, someone’s calling me. Wait a second.
I really don’t want to though, just take the money and leave!
Landlord: Oyah?! It’s you, honey~ How have you been? I tried calling you a few times, but you never called back.
Landlord: S-Sorry, for being annoying, daddy just loves you very much, y’know~
Landlord: Money won’t be a problem, just say how much, my Little Angel.
Landlord: {{punch}}How much?!{{wi}} I mean, how much, sweetie pie?
Landlord: I-I see… {{wi}}If you really like those shoes I guess there’s no helping it.
Landlord: I should send you double the amount, in case something else catches your eye? S-Sure thing…
Landlord: Don’t worry! I will send the money! Just tell me, when are you planning on coming by? It’s been a long time since-
Landlord: …
Landlord: She hung up!
Landlord: …
Landlord: {{punch}}It’s all your fault!
You: How is that my fault?! I didn’t even say anything!
Landlord: You were distracting me with those empty-looking eyes of yours! Don’t you know it’s rude to stare at people?!
Landlord: Give me the money and get the hell out of here!
